svg.text: MS-TM01 · TRAIL MULE · PROTOTYPE 001 · REV A

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: 04 / POWDER BLUE · FOG GRID · US M 12 2E
GROUND FACE · TOE LEFT · PLUS LUGS AS OBSERVED CHARACTER
SIDEWALL PROFILE · WAVE AND TOE BUMPER

g.text: O1 One black rubber bottom is what the card shows: sidewall, toe bumper, and lug field read as one sculpted unit.
O2 A separate rand is not drawn. Add one only if the sourced sole does not already include the raised wall.
O3 Lug family on the card: plus-form, multi-directional, with a small center pip. This layout is a schematic, not a mold.
O4 Do not name or imply a commercial outsole brand. None has been selected.
O5 Bond surface is the cavity and the top of the wall. Its outline comes from the physical sole, not from this drawing.
O6 Sidewall top edge is a wave: higher at the toe bumper and the heel, lower through the waist.
O7 Toe bumper wraps the round toe. The textile toe sits behind the rubber, not in front of it.
Target: US M 12 2E compatible sole. A nominal size 12 sole is not assumed to fit a 2E last.

svg.text: No manufacturer is specified. The plus lug is recorded as observed character so a sourced sole can be compared with the card.
SCALE NTS · PROPORTION MODEL FROM THE REFERENCE CARD · NOT A MEASURED DRAWING · PROVISIONAL — PHYSICAL VALIDATION REQUIRED
WORDMARK STAND-IN: MADE / SAiNT, LOWERCASE i REQUIRED. MATCH THE FOUNDER FILE. DO NOT CUT FROM THIS SHEET.
